Id is now we are blasting you to molecules, to be delayed only for the abount of seconds id takes for you to turn ober the Prime Mover frob your vile clutches!|An [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]]|<ref name="SH ">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>}}
The '''Prime Mover''' was the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] name for a prototype [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] that the species scavenged from the wreckage of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The piece of Death Star wreckage in which the projector was housed was known as the [[Holiest of Holies]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|technology|gravitywellprojector|gravity well projector}}.</ref> or Holy of Holies.<ref name="SH " />

The Ugors toted the projector to their home, the junk-filled [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]], where their [[priest-scientist]]s investigated it to find its use. When they turned it on, they found that it generated powerful gravitational energy. They tweaked it so that it could organize and order the refuse floating throughout the Paradise system. This enabled the Ugors to operate more efficiently and further surpass their rivals, the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]], in the galactic rubbish collection business. The species' religious leaders recorded the arrival of the Prime Mover in the Paradise system as a momentous occasion, which they dubbed the "Coming of the Prime Mover." The Ugors set up a picket line of [[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|''Black Hole''-class Salvage Dreadnoughts]] to protect the holy relic.<ref name="SH " />

Sometime before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="date">The date of [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']] is not given in the adventure, but it must occur before this date, as the Death Star has been destroyed and [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] has not yet been assigned to Echo Base.</ref> however, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike force and a Squib diplomat infiltrated the Paradise system and removed the gravity well projector. The system fell back into chaos as a result.<ref name="SH " />
